degree.text: Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration

description.text: Educational Objective The program pursues to train senior managerial professionals equipped with sound business management knowledge and capabilities as well as an international vision and pioneering spirit. Curricula 16 units in total: Accounting for Managers, Marketing, Human Resource Management, Business Finance, International Trade Law, Management Communication, Organizational Behavior, Economics for Managers, Statistical Analysis & Decision Making, Management Ethics, International Business, Strategic Management, Production and Operations Management, Chinse Language, China Brief and Chinese Economy and Cultural. Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration Career Graduates can engage in the field of human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Computer Experimental Center(click the pics to enlarge) Teacher Highlight Shan Fengru (Professor of Bohai University)

duration.text: The MBA at Bohai University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport The first page of the passport (Indentity Page).With photo, passport number & expiration date and full name. Two blank pages of the passport. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, who haven’t broken laws, are required to have bachelor degree.
